name: shell-topbar-grid
description: Top navigation + a widget grid of independent tiles. The main region is not a single content area.
provenPattern: Shell matrix — chrome × body: 5 chromes × 4 bodies = 20, four eliminated (with no chrome a grid has no way out, a dense surface has no interaction, a split refutes itself) → 16 cells.

knowledge.purpose: The frame of a scanned board: every tile is fed from its own source; the user scans, not reads
antiPatterns: Turning the tiles into one long content area — that is the flow body
Giving one tile the full page height — a board must be scanned at a glance
Leaving scan order to grid order — on a narrow screen priority must be declared SEPARATELY

mobileCollapse: The top bar collapses into a drawer; links are listed in one column. The grid collapses to one column and tile priority is declared SEPARATELY — grid order does not give it.

placeholders.{{MAIN}}: main slot — TILES only (cards, stats, charts): every child is one grid cell, so a page band does not go here
placeholders.{{LEGAL}}: copyright / legal line — PLAIN TEXT, one line (e.g. "© 2026 Acme Ltd."). The ONLY place the copyright appears: the `footer` band carries link columns and never a copyright. Leave it empty ("") for none
